full_text:
Ironhead arrow

Internal ID: ArrowIron | Type: Arrow | Source: Forge | Usage: Bow ammunition | Crafting Materials: Wood x8, Iron x1, Feathers x2

Introduction. Ironhead arrows are ammunition for bows and are the next direct upgrade from bronzehead arrows.

Availability. • Ironhead arrows can be found in Sunken Crypts within the Swamp biome.
• They are unlocked after acquiring iron and are crafted in the forge.
